hints.text: Check the order of operations. The grouping symbols show which part of the expression must be done first.
Add inside the parentheses first: $7 + 3 = 10$. The expression then becomes $5 \times 10$.

explanation: Parentheses show which part to do first, so add inside them: $7 + 3 = 10$.
Replace the parentheses with that sum, and the expression becomes $5 \times 10$.
Multiply to finish: $5 \times 10 = 50$, so the value is $50$.
